_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 79: 4-10 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are all talking about 2027, 2030 and these things and people had better wake up, that this is why he sees Poland and things happening with war, that he saw Apollyon coming out of the pit and spin around and start influencing Putin, and that the angel said to look at the fig tree and look at Israel.
mentions.quote: Polyon coming out of the pit and spin around and started influencing uh Putin
mentions.falsify_match: Major war spreading through Poland with Russia driving it before 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such war. The years have moved: this claim was originally attached to 2025 being war war, and now sits on 2027 to 2030. A demonic influence on a head of state has no test attached at all.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a divine reversal, saying that as it was on the water the Lord said speak to the water and he saw the water, calls healing and deliverance over their bodies, and thanks God that there are no cancers, no heart disease and no clogged arteries whatever it may be, addressing those whose doctor is saying there is no hope for them.
mentions.quote: we thank you Lord that there is no cancers
mentions.falsify_match: Documented remission in people who received this declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None operable. Declaring a condition absent is not a prediction that it will resolve, so no later medical outcome can contradict it. This is the same structure as symptoms not counting.

mentions.claim_text: He voices an exchange about what the doctors say and answers that it is a report which he appreciates, that they are not attacking the doctors who are just doing their job, but that he believes Jesus is a healer and will bring a divine reversal, asks whether they believe it with him, and extends the same to someone who has received divorce papers in the mail.
mentions.quote: I appreciate your report. We're not attacking the doctors
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a diagnosis is reclassified as a report rather than a fact.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The move is explicit and polite: the doctors are not attacked, their finding is simply demoted to a report, which places any medical outcome outside the reach of the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts telling the Lord he was not complaining anymore and being answered that his heart was full of it and that he complains in his heart rather than with his mouth, that he said he would be doing this for the rest of his life and was told no he would not, to keep going and give thanks and glory for everything, and describes thanking God while cleaning toilets and cleaning up after children.
mentions.quote: You may not say it with your mouth and complain to Diana anymore
mentions.falsify_match: A personal word already met: he is no longer cleaning bathrooms.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a as told. Recorded because it is a rare case of a claim with a stated outcome, though the outcome is one only he can attest and the word is recounted after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is why they are covering him in prayer to get him over the finish line, that he saw cement blocks on his feet, and that the Lord said it will be up to the church to get him over the threshold of the finish line of his presidency going into 2028.
mentions.quote: it will be up to the church to get him over the threshold
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by construction: the outcome is assigned to the church in advance.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Second passage in a week placing responsibility on the audience before the result is known. Cement blocks on his feet gives the impediment without naming anything that could be observed.

mentions.claim_text: He notes reports of archaeological discoveries possibly locating the Ten Commandments and the Ark of the Covenant, says the Lord showed them back in February that they would find a significant artifact in the days ahead and that when they find it it will be a shock and awe to the world, that he saw Aaron's rod and all kinds of tablets and believes it will bring many into the kingdom because it will prove the Bible authentic, and that he heard earthquakes will take place and shake the soil when they uncover it.
mentions.quote: When they find this, it's going to be a shock and awe to the world
mentions.falsify_match: A verified find of the Ark, the tablets or Aaron's rod, accompanied by earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No find. He is treating a news item about a possible location as the word coming to pass, which is a long way from the artifact being recovered. Some kind of significant artifact is broad enough that most seasons of archaeology would supply one.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying they do not realise what their prayers did for July 4th, that in the days ahead they will see the manifestation of what they did for July 4th, that what was on the surface will be revealed, and declares things covered to be revealed.
mentions.quote: In the days ahead you'll see the manifestation of this
mentions.falsify_match: Something surfacing that can be tied to the 4 July prayers.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The manifestation is unnamed, the timing is the days ahead, and the credit is claimed for an event that did not happen on the day itself.

mentions.claim_text: He says he prays for the nation and for Cuba and believes they will be liberated in the days ahead, citing Ezekiel 38 and 39 standing at the door, that they are praying through the next six months to the first of the year, that the Fourth of July has passed and they are praying for the World Cup, and that Mexico lost last night and there was rioting, which is what he saw when he told them to pray for the green and white jerseys, showing footage from Los Angeles where people lost their lives.
mentions.quote: I said pray for the green and white jerseys
mentions.falsify_match: The original green and white jerseys word predating the match and the rioting.
mentions.falsify_miss: The word postdates it, or the jerseys do not match. This is checkable: Mexico's colours are green and white, the fixture list was public, and the original statement should be datable inside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that he sees a storm cloud parting over Cuba, repeating it, and calls the storm cloud parting even before November, saying it is because of November, that time is running out and they have to get all these major things done before the election in November because he is concerned about losing it, then declares over the intelligence.
mentions.quote: I see a storm cloud parting over Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A visible change in Cuba before the November election.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing changes. Storm cloud parting is not defined, and this moves the Cuban timing forward from the 2027 liberation already on file.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is coming is not what people expect, that a red dawn experience and a shaking to awaken that brings the bride to her side is not an act of terror but an act of war, and that the Lord showed him these are not terrorists in the nation but soldiers who infiltrated because of the Biden administration.
mentions.quote: this is soldiers that have infiltrated because of the Biden
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in America carried out by foreign military personnel who entered during that administration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. The distinction he draws, war rather than terror, is the same one that lets an ordinary terrorist incident be excluded as not what he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they would bury him on Fourth of July weekend while America celebrates its 250th and answers that it is symbolic for them and that they want revenge, that it is ignorant to think they would not retaliate for all their leaders taken out by America and Israel, and that he saw retaliation coming against Israel and America.
mentions.quote: to bury him on Fourth of July weekend when America is celebrating their 250th
mentions.falsify_match: A retaliatory attack over the 250th anniversary weekend.
mentions.falsify_miss: The weekend passes without one, which is what happened. Now past due and scoreable, and the reasoning offered is inference from a burial date rather than something he says he was shown.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that the FBI is surging hundreds of personnel from around the country to aid the ongoing investigation of the 2020 election in Georgia, and asks what they saw earlier in the week, answering that he saw Stacy Abrams and the Lord said great fraud in Atlanta and that he saw major fraud in Atlanta.
mentions.quote: I saw Stacy Abrams and the Lord said great fraud in Atlanta
mentions.falsify_match: Findings of fraud in Atlanta arising from that investigation.
mentions.falsify_miss: The investigation finds nothing. The interval is short and both ends are inside this corpus, days rather than months, so whether the word preceded the news is settleable. An investigation being staffed is not fraud being established.
